criterion: which news topic area the article covers

categories.name: Economy
categories.definition: News related to national and international economic performance, financial markets, trade, employment, and fiscal policy.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: News covering various sports, competitions, teams, athletes, and related management or controversies.

categories.name: Arts and Culture
categories.definition: News about music, film, theatre, literature, visual arts, museums, and entertainment events, including celebrity news within these fields.

categories.name: Business
categories.definition: News focusing on companies, industries, corporate finance, mergers, acquisitions, profits, and business-related legal issues.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: News about computing, internet, software, hardware, consumer electronics, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and digital trends, including gaming.

categories.name: Politics
categories.definition: News concerning national and local government, elections, political parties, policy debates, legislation, and political controversies within a country.

categories.name: International Affairs
categories.definition: News about global events, foreign policy, international relations, humanitarian crises, and significant political or social developments in specific countries that have broader international implications.

categories.name: Media
categories.definition: News about the media industry, including television, radio, print, and online platforms, their content, ratings, and related legal or ethical issues.

categories.name: Health
categories.definition: News related to public health, diseases, medical research, and healthcare policy.

categories.name: Environment
categories.definition: News concerning environmental issues, climate change, conservation, and environmental policy.
